text:
Samir: Quick heads-up — onboarding PulseFin LoRA adapter. Quickpack shows tiny invoice amount drift after int4 quant. fp16 ok, q4_0 has +/-0.01-0.05 on a few samples.

Megan: ugh. which quant config and artifacts?

Samir: Ran: ./evalpack/run_quickpack.sh --model base-variant-fp16 --adapter pulsefin-lora.safetensors --quant q4_0 --prompts tests/pulsefin/invoice-amounts.jsonl. Snippet:
{"id":"inv-014","fp16_amount":"1234.50","q4_amount":"1234.47","delta":-0.03}
{"id":"inv-078","fp16_amount":"9.99","q4_amount":"9.94","delta":-0.05}
Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/pulsefin/quickpack/6823456789/

Ravi: adapter doing arithmetic or templated completions?

Samir: templated LM completions. Prompts include currency symbols and some thin-space thousands separators.

Tay: paste failing prompt? tokenization boundary could split numbers.

Samir: "Generate invoice total for items: [\"Subscription: $9.99\", \"Overage: $0.00\"] -> Total:" -> q4: "$9.94"

Julie: small numeric drift often from quant noise + greedy decoding. Did you save logits?

Samir: re-ran 20 failing examples with --save-logits --max-tokens 128, uploaded to same s3 path.

ci-bot: Adapter passed model-signing and checksum validation.

Ravi: quick glance at logits: for inv-078 the "." token logit fp16 ~ -1.2 vs q4 ~ -1.8; last digit token delta ~ -0.3. q4 shows slight downward bias on digit tokens.

Megan: that suggests qpack asymmetric zero-point or kernel scaling. Which toolchain?

Samir: vendor q4_0. We have q4_aw sandbox.

Tay: try q4_aw and disable kv-cache warmstart; also test merge-then-quant vs runtime-LoRA-on-q4.

Samir: queued q4_aw + kv warmstart off. Running merged-then-quant and runtime-lora-on-q4 now.

Samir: merged->quant result: median delta ~0.01 with few outliers (~0.03). runtime-on-q4 median ~0.04. Uploaded artifacts.

Megan: create targeted eval: 100 templated invoices varying separators, currencies, magnitudes (0.00, 10,000.00, 9999999.99). Score = normalized abs delta + format-preserved flag. Pass if abs_delta<=0.02 (<100) else <=0.1 (>1e6).

Samir: will run overnight and drop results in morning. Adding prompt-mitigation note: enforce exact two-decimal format via system instruction as temporary workaround.

Megan: policy: if >5% fail, block q4 rollout for PulseFin until mitigation.

Ravi: we'll triage at standup and draft remediation doc: options = merged-then-quant, q4_aw profile, or keep fp16 for monetary fields.

Julie: include delta.py diff scripts in artifacts so support can reproduce.

Samir: done. tagging @ravi @megan for follow-up. :coffee:
